device.description: 16-bit voltage-output DAC with 2's complement input, power-on reset to midscale, 24-bit SPI-compatible write-only interface and VFB feedback pin
device.note: dac8550.pdf (SLAS476H) p.4 pin functions, p.5 recommended operating conditions (VDD 2.7-5.5 V), p.7 timing requirements and Figure 1, p.17 2's complement input coding (Equation 1) and power-on reset to midscale, p.18 power-down modes (Table 1) and serial interface, p.19 input shift register (Figure 49) and SYNC interrupt (Figure 50)

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: DAC register; power-on reset sets the output to midscale, which is code 0000h in the 2's complement input coding (p.17)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: PD1/PD0 (DB17-DB16) of the last valid frame: 00 normal, 01 1 kOhm, 10 100 kOhm, 11 Hi-Z

commands.name: WRITE
commands.note: DB23-DB18 don't care, DB17-DB16 PD1/PD0, DB15-DB0 data MSB first; executed on the 24th SCLK falling edge; SYNC high earlier aborts the frame (SYNC interrupt)

pages: p.4 (pins), p.5 (ROC), p.7 (timing, Figure 1), p.17 (2's complement coding, power-on reset to midscale), p.18 (power-down Table 1, serial interface), p.19 (input shift register Figure 49, SYNC interrupt Figure 50)
notModeled: analog output, resistor string, output amplifier and VFB feedback input (VOUT is never driven)
power-down output loads (1 kOhm / 100 kOhm / Hi-Z): PD1/PD0 stored in CTRL.PD only; the DAC register keeps its contents
power-down exit time (2.5 us at 5 V, 5 us at 3 V) and output settling
SCLK frequency (20 MHz below VDD 3.6 V, 30 MHz above) and setup/hold limits t1-t8
SPI mode: data taken on SCLK falling edges, SCLK high at SYNC fall in the timing figure; modeled as mode 2
2's complement coding is analog-only: the register stores the code as written; midscale = 0000h
variants: dac8550.pdf covers only the DAC8550 (A and B grades: DAC8550IDGK*/DAC8550IBDGK*). The DAC8551 is the straight-binary version (own datasheet).
